Nina K: Quick Q 3/12 I paid for a late-night taxi from SFO to my hotel on my personal card because the company card declined. No itemized receipt, just the app credit card charge screenshot for $48.22 USD. Does that fly for reimbursement?
Raj P: Hi Nina 3 we can reimburse but we need proof of trip and manager approval. Do you have a screenshot from the taxi app or Google Maps trip? Also please confirm reason company card declined (was it soft-decline or blocked?).
Nina K: Attached: CC-DECLINE.png and charge-screenshot.png. It shows masked PAN and amount, no driver receipt. The card soft-declined (bank flagged foreign? but its a domestic transaction). I tried corp card later and it worked.
Finance Bot: Policy note: For transportation under $75, a card charge screenshot + trip confirmation (map or booking) is acceptable if manager approves. Missing receipts >$75 require vendor invoice.
Nina K: Adding trip map screenshot now. It was a last-minute split ride after event close. Manager is Lily M.
Lily M: Approved. Thanks for flagging, Nina. Please tag AP and include a brief note of business purpose (team offsite travel) and cost center.
Nina K: Business purpose: On-call coverage at Bay Area demo site (team offsite). Cost center: ENG-TRAVEL-Q1.
Raj P: Forward this bundle into Concur and select expense type "Ground Transport - No Receipt" and attach the screenshots. Use GL code 6110. AP will process within standard cycle unless queue urgent.
Nina K: FYI I need funds sooner than normal because my statement posts tomorrow. Can AP expedite?
AP Team Bot: We can offer a 48hr expedited reimbursement for card-decline exceptions with manager approval. Nina, please mark "expedite" in Concur notes and CC ap@redwood.com. Fee-free.
Lily M: Marking expedite and CCing AP in Concur now.
Raj P: All set from finance side. Once AP confirms receipt of Concur file we'll push it through.
AP Team Bot: Received Concur submission and expedite flag. Expected payout in 2 business days.
Nina K: Really appreciate the quick turnaround, thanks everyone :pray:
